entries.label: 3-D Metal Printing
entries.quote: Now printers can make metal objects quickly and cheaply.

entries.label: Artificial Embryos
entries.quote: Without using eggs or sperm cells, researchers have made embryo-like structures from stem cells alone.

entries.label: Sensing City
entries.availability: Project announced October 2017; construction could begin in 2019
entries.quote: A Toronto neighborhood aims to be the first place to successfully integrate cutting-edge urban design with digital technology.
entries.note: horizon parsed from 'construction could begin in 2019'; the claim is a construction start, not availability.

entries.label: AI for Everybody
entries.quote: Cloud-based AI is making the technology cheaper and easier to use.

entries.label: Dueling Neural Networks
entries.quote: Two AI systems can spar with each other to create ultra-realistic original images or sounds.

entries.label: Babel-Fish Earbuds
entries.quote: Near-real-time translation now works for a large number of languages and is easy to use.

entries.label: Zero-Carbon Natural Gas
entries.quote: A power plant efficiently and cheaply captures carbon released by burning natural gas.

entries.label: Perfect Online Privacy
entries.quote: Computer scientists are perfecting a cryptographic tool for proving something without revealing underlying information.

entries.label: Genetic Fortune-Telling
entries.quote: Scientists can now use your genome to predict chances of getting heart disease, breast cancer, and even IQ.

entries.label: Materials' Quantum Leap
entries.quote: IBM has simulated the electronic structure of a small molecule using a seven-qubit quantum computer.

notes: Ten entries. Every entry has Breakthrough / Why It Matters / Key Players / Availability. Quote is the Breakthrough line. horizon is a parsed band: 'now' or 'A-B years'. Person names dropped from key players.
